column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_underground.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Prepares the layer-0 display list for a frame: world_underground_init_render_state(list) and then world_underground_set_camera on the result; returns the advanced display-list pointer (the decompiler shows void, the caller uses v0). Side effects: GE commands, gum matrices. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw). The pack header's twin match with BOOT system_net_api_get_alive_peer_count is a false positive (jal targets masked).

Writes the module's base 3D render state: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport centre (0x800, 0x800) 480x272, depth range 0xffff..0, blend (add, src alpha, 1-src alpha), scissor 480x272, alpha test (greater, 0, 0xff), depth test (func 7), back-face culling, shade model 1, colour white, fog 50.0..100.0 colour 0x404040 (then disables state 7), projection gum_ortho(-240, 240, -136, 136, -10000, 10000) scaled by the vector at 0x00016a40, identity view and model, clear colour/depth/stencil 0 with clear flags 0x17, texture filter 1/1, ambient 0xffffffff, lighting on and light 0 off. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands and gum matrices. Callers: 1 (world_underground_begin_3d_frame).

Loads the view matrix with field_3d_camera_set_look_at(eye 0x00016a50, target 0x00016a60, up 0x00016a70) (constant 16-byte vectors copied to the stack), marks the gum matrix dirty and resets the model matrix to identity. Returns list unchanged. Side effects: gum matrices. Callers: 1 (world_underground_begin_3d_frame).
Initialises the 16-byte floor view record: +0x00 = 0, +0x04 (floor) = 1, +0x08 (map tier) = 0, +0x0c = 0. No return value. Side effects: the record. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_init).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_end).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_map(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Draws the ladder map of the current floor as 2D sprites by chaining, on the same display list, world_underground_draw_map_background, world_underground_draw_map_frame, world_underground_draw_rungs, world_underground_draw_placed_rungs, world_underground_draw_ladder_lines, world_underground_draw_ladder_cells and world_underground_draw_end_row, each with the scroll offset (scroll_x, scroll_y). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_draw, game object draw).

Stores floor at view +0x04 and the map tier (floor - 1) / 10 at +0x08 (the tier selects which mini_dj_map01_<n> texture set world_underground_get_map_tier_gim returns). No return value. Side effects: the view record. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_setup_floor).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_map_background(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Copies the 13 sprite records of 8 words at 0x00016a80 (member id, x, y, u, v, width, height, flip) and draws each one; whenever the member id differs from the previous record's it binds a new texture with world_underground_get_map_tier_gim(member, view +0x08) and field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0 and resets blend/alpha-test/texture-function state. Sprites are placed at (x - scroll_x, y - scroll_y * 0x1f0 / 0x4f0), a vertical parallax of about 0.39. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_map_frame(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Draws the 10 sprite records of 8 words at 0x00016c20 (member id, x, y, u, v, width, height, flip) at (x - scroll_x, y - scroll_y), binding a texture with world_underground_get_member(member) each time the member changes. view is unused. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_ladder_lines(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Binds member 0x10 and draws, for each of the 5 columns, 0x2a copies of the sprite record at 0x00016d60 stacked vertically at x = column x (world_underground_get_column_x) - 0x10 and y = 0x70 + i * sprite height, minus the scroll: the vertical lines of the ladder (hypothesis, confidence medium). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_ladder_cells(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Binds member 0x10 and for each column 0..4 and row 1..16 draws one of the three sprite records copied from 0x00016d80: record 2 when world_underground_ladder_can_place_left(column, row) is true, else record 1 when world_underground_ladder_can_place_right(column, row) is true, else record 0, at (world_underground_get_column_x(column) - 0x10, world_underground_get_row_y(row) - 0xc) minus the scroll. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_end_row(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Binds member 0xc and picks the end row: row 0 when the floor at view +0x04 is even, row 0x11 when it is odd. For each of the 5 columns draws record 0 of 0x00016de0 when world_underground_ladder_is_down_stairs(column, row) is true, else record 1 when world_underground_ladder_is_up_stairs is true, else record 2 when world_underground_ladder_is_exit is true (otherwise nothing), at (column x - 0x10, row y - 0x10) minus the scroll. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_rungs(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Binds member 0x10 and for each of the 4 gaps between columns (world_underground_get_gap_x) and each row 1..16 draws the sprite record at 0x00016e40 at (x - 0x44, row y - 8) minus the scroll when world_underground_ladder_is_rung_slot(gap, row) is true and both world_underground_ladder_is_rung_empty and world_underground_ladder_is_rung_placed are false: the fixed rungs of the ladder (slot value 1). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_placed_rungs(void *view, void *list, int scroll_x, int scroll_y)
column3: Binds member 0xc and for each of the 4 gaps and rows 0..17 draws the sprite record at 0x00016e60 at (gap x - 0x41, row y - 10) minus the scroll when world_underground_ladder_is_rung_slot(gap, row) is true, world_underground_ladder_is_rung_empty is false and world_underground_ladder_is_rung_placed is true: the rungs added with a tool (slot value 2), which world_underground_draw_rungs leaves out. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map).

Scene start of the underground mini-game: releases all sound banks and loads tracks 0x2c8 and 0x2d3, initialises the layer-0 render state, installs world_underground_heap_alloc / 0x00002774 as the field_3d allocator, creates the 1 MB module heap (world_underground_create_heap), clears the 0x1330-byte scene state at 0x00018b90, loads the save progress (world_underground_load_progress), sets the scene state 0x18b90 and the duel_mgr-loaded flag 0x18b94 to 0, sets the entry mode 0x19e38 to 2 when arg is 0 (title intro plays) or 0 otherwise, starts a fade (type 1, black, 1 frame) and stops all sounds. Returns 1. Side effects: audio, heap, globals 0x00018b90..0x00019ec4. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_init).

Scene end: when rel_duel_mgr was loaded as a library (world_underground_is_duel_mgr_loaded) calls system_duel_mgr_scene_shutdown and system_module_unload(0x13); then destroys the module heap, terminates the field_3d render state and releases tracks 0x2c8 and 0x2d3. Returns 1. Side effects: module unload, heap, audio. Callers: 1 (thunk_FUN_000011d0); reached as the scene end callback (hypothesis, confidence medium).

Per-frame scene update: calls world_underground_update_nop, then dispatches on the scene state 0x00018b90: 0 (and any unknown value) world_underground_enter_title, 1 world_underground_update_title, 2 world_underground_start_game, 3 world_underground_update_game, 4 world_underground_start_result, 5 world_underground_update_result, 6 stops all sounds. Returns 1 in state 6 (scene finished), else 0. Side effects: those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_step).

Per-frame draw: layer 0 gets world_underground_begin_3d_frame; layer 1 draws the title object 0x00018be0 (0x0000b1c4) in state 1, the game object 0x00019160 (0x00002f84) in state 3 or the result object 0x00019e20 (0x0000e200) in state 5; layer 4 draws the fade overlay (system_draw_fade) in state 3 when 0x000034a4(game) is true and 0x000034b8(game) false, or in state 1 when 0x0000b340(title) is false; and in state 1 with title substate 0x19e3c 3..5 plays the intro ehf 0x19e40 (frame counter 0x19e50 incremented) between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. No return value. Side effects: GE commands, 0x19e50. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_frame).

Writes the flag 0x00018b94 that records that rel_duel_mgr (module 0x13) is loaded as a library (the only caller passes 1). No return value. Side effects: 0x18b94. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_state_init_duel_lib).

Returns the flag 0x00018b94 (rel_duel_mgr loaded). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_underground_scene_end, world_underground_title_state_confirm_floor, world_underground_title_state_wait_fade, world_underground_title_state_confirm_enter).
True when the scene state 0x18b90 is 3 (game running) and world_underground_game_is_duel_lib_active(game object 0x19160) returns non-zero. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_frame).

Returns 0x00018bdc, the exit code set before state 6 (1 = leave, from title choice 3 or the result screen; 2 = deck editor, title choice 2). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_step).

Loads the run state from the save: 0x18ba0 = save_get_duelist_level() * 100, 0x18ba4 = save_get_player_value(0) (DP), and from the 0x30-byte save_get_minigame_block_3 block: +0x00 floor -> 0x18ba8, +0x04 best floor -> 0x18bac (each clamped to 1..100, floor then limited to the best), +0x08..+0x24 eight slot words -> 0x18bb0 (each reset to 0 outside 0..4), +0x28 run-in-progress flag -> 0x18b98, +0x2c value -> 0x18b9c (reset to 2 outside 0..4). Clears 0x18bd0..0x18bdc and initialises the title (0x0000af78), game (0x000029d4) and result (0x0000e110) objects at 0x18be0, 0x19160 and 0x19e20. No return value. Side effects: those globals and objects. Callers: 2 (world_underground_scene_start, world_underground_update_result).

State 0 handler: starts the title object 0x18be0 with 0x0000b2cc(title, DP 0x18ba4, floor 0x18ba8, best 0x18bac, mode == 2, mode == 0), sets the scene state to 1, clears the intro ehf pointer 0x19e40 and its 0x60-byte parameter block 0x19e50, and sets the title substate 0x19e3c to 0 (intro) when the entry mode 0x19e38 is 2, else 6. No return value. Side effects: those globals, title object. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).

State 1 handler. Runs the intro substate 0x19e3c: 0 -> 1; 1 starts a white fade (16 frames); 2 waits for the fade and the title object's ready test 0x0000b32c, then plays sound 0x7aad and the ehf member 0 (frames 0..0xd); 3 waits until frame > 0xb then holds frame 0xd; 4 holds 0x3c frames then plays frames 0x14..0x1c; 5 waits until frame > 0x1a; 6 waits for 0x0000b32c, calls 0x0000b354 and hides the loading overlay; 7 idle. Every frame, when the title is done (0x0000b084) it reads the choice 0x0000b360: 3 -> exit code 1, state 6; 2 -> exit code 2, state 6; 1 (new run) -> run flag 0x18b98 = 0, floor = world_underground_title_get_start_floor, DP -= world_underground_title_get_fee (also save_add_dp(-fee)), state 2; 0 (continue) -> state 2. For choices 0 and 1 the floor, best floor and eight slots are written back to the save block, and the title object is ended (0x0000b04c). No return value. Side effects: scene globals, save block, DP, sounds, fade. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).
Returns title +0x1c, the DP cost of the chosen start (subtracted with save_add_dp). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_title).
Returns title +0x18, the floor chosen to start a new run. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_title).

State 2 handler: loads track 0x2d3 and starts the game object 0x19160 with 0x00003394(game, run flag 0x18b98, value 0x18b9c, floor 0x18ba8, level*100 0x18ba0 twice, slots 0x18bb0) (sixth and seventh arguments in t0-t2), then sets the scene state to 3. No return value. Side effects: audio, game object, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).

State 3 handler: once the game object reports done (0x00002c5c) sets 0x19e34 = 1 and state 4, then by outcome (world_underground_game_get_outcome): 2 (run suspended) -> run flag = 1, 0x18b9c = 0x00003588(game), floor = world_underground_game_get_floor, best = max(best, floor), slots from world_underground_game_get_slot, show-reward flag 0x18bd0 = 1; 1 -> run reset (0x18b9c = 2, floor 1, slots cleared, flag 0) with best kept, 0x18bd0 = 0; 0 -> full reset including best = 1, 0x18bd0 = 1. Writes floor, best, slots, run flag and 0x18b9c back to the save block (+0x00..+0x2c), stores 0x18bd8 = world_underground_game_get_duels_won and, when 0x18bd0 is set, calls 0x00003534, takes the reward 0x18bd4 = world_underground_game_get_floors_gained and calls save_set_progress_flag_e9_bit5 when the outcome was 0 or the best floor exceeds 0x31. Finally ends the game object (0x00002ba8). No return value. Side effects: scene globals, save block, progress flag. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).
Returns game +0x48, the net floors climbed in this run (raised by stairs up, lowered by stairs down and result 0xd), or 0 when negative. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns game +0x4c, the number of duels won in this run (passed to the result screen). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns the slot word game +0x24 + index * 4 (eight slots, saved in the save block +0x08). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns game +0x44, the floor reached. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns game +0x16c, the run outcome (0, 1 or 2, see world_underground_update_game). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).

State 4 handler: starts the result object 0x19e20 with 0x0000e234(result, show flag 0x18bd0, reward 0x18bd4, value 0x18bd8) and sets the scene state to 5. No return value. Side effects: result object, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).

State 5 handler: when the result object is done (0x0000e160) reads its choice (0x0000e244): 1 -> exit code 1 and state 6; 0 -> reloads the progress (world_underground_load_progress), entry mode 0x19e38 = 1, state 0 and title substate 6 (back to the title without the intro). Then ends the result object (0x0000e158). No return value. Side effects: scene globals. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).

column2: void * ui_call_draw_sprite_region(void *list, int x, int y, int u, int v, int width, int height)
column3: Same code as rel_duel_draw ui_call_draw_sprite_region (arguments 5-7 in t0-t2): draws the texture rectangle (u, v, width x height) unscaled at (x, y) through ui_draw_sprite_region(list, x, y, u, v, width, height, width, height). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 13 (world_underground_box_draw, world_underground_duelist_draw, world_underground_player_draw, world_underground_hud_draw_lp, ...).

No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 4 (ui_call_draw_sprite_region, world_underground_title_draw_help_images, world_underground_darkness_draw, world_underground_title_draw_help_frame).

column2: void * world_underground_draw_sprite_rotated(void *list, int x, int y, int u, int v, int width, int height, int flip)
column3: Draws the texture region (u, v, width x height) at (x, y) with system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped(flip_xy = flip); for flip codes 1 and 3 the destination extent is height x width (swapped), for all other codes it is width x height (arguments 5-8 in t0-t3). Returns the display-list pointer left in v0 by system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped, which both callers chain as the list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_draw_column_arrows, world_underground_game_draw_scroll_arrows).

True when mask intersects the held-buttons word of system_pad_get_state(): +0x00 for source 0 or 2, +0x18 for source 1 or 2. No side effects. Callers: 7 (world_underground_game_handle_cursor, world_underground_game_state_view_map, world_underground_game_walk_player, world_underground_game_state_choose_column, ...).

True when mask intersects the newly-pressed word of system_pad_get_state(): +0x04 for source 0 or 2, +0x1c for source 1 or 2. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_underground_game_handle_cursor, world_underground_pad_confirm_pressed, world_underground_pad_cancel_pressed).

True when mask intersects the auto-repeat word of system_pad_get_state(): +0x0c for source 0 or 2, +0x24 for source 1 or 2. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_underground_title_step_floor_picker, world_underground_game_state_choose_column, world_underground_title_step_help).

Returns world_underground_pad_is_pressed(system_get_confirm_button(0), 2): the confirm button was pressed this frame (the decompiler drops the returned value). No side effects. Callers: 8 (world_underground_title_step_floor_picker, world_underground_game_state_view_map, world_underground_game_is_effect_done, world_underground_game_state_choose_column, ...).

Returns world_underground_pad_is_pressed(system_get_confirm_button(1), 2): the cancel button was pressed this frame. No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_underground_title_step_floor_picker, world_underground_game_state_view_map, world_underground_game_state_choose_column, world_underground_title_step_help).

Maps save_get_language() to the module's text/graphics language index: 0 -> 4, 1 -> 0, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 1, 4 -> 3, 5 -> 5, other -> 4. No side effects. Callers: 13 (world_underground_open_list_window, world_underground_title_draw_help, world_underground_get_strtbl_path, world_underground_game_show_text, ...).
Returns the constant 2. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_draw_floor_picker).

Clears the load state 0x19ed0, the heap handle 0x19ec4 and the four two-word sdchr slots at 0x19ed4, allocates 1 MB (0x100000) from the sound heap (audio_print_sound_heap_usage returns it) into 0x19ec0 and creates the module heap 0x19ec4 on it with system_heap_create. No return value. Side effects: those globals, sound-heap allocation. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_start).

When the module heap 0x19ec4 exists, releases it (system_free_aligned), frees its 1 MB block 0x19ec0 back to the sound heap and clears 0x19ec4. Returns 1. Side effects: heap release, 0x19ec4. Callers: 1 (world_underground_scene_end).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update).

column2: void world_underground_load_archive(int index, void *callback, int arg, int map_index)
column3: Loads entry index of the archive table at 0x00016e80 (stride 0x24: a 0x20-byte path, then the loaded pointer at +0x20, i.e. 0x00016ea0 + index * 0x24). When the entry is not loaded: load state 0x19ed0 = 1; the path comes from 0x000028f0(index, buf) for entries 1, 3 and 5, from the map-name table 0x00017258 + map_index * 0x20 for entry 4, otherwise from the table itself (entry 0 = underground/titlemenu_com.ehp); starts the load with 0x000027c0(path, &entry pointer, 1) and stores callback/arg in 0x19ec8/0x19ecc for the completion. When it is already loaded, calls callback(pointer, arg) at once unless callback is NULL. No return value. Side effects: archive table, load globals. Callers: 4 (world_underground_game_state_load, world_underground_result_state_load, world_underground_title_state_load, world_underground_game_state_load_map).

Returns the loaded pointer of archive entry index (0x00016ea0 + index * 0x24), NULL when not loaded. No side effects. Callers: 7 (world_underground_title_draw_floor_picker, world_underground_title_build_help, world_underground_hud_build_floor_label, world_underground_result_state_open, ...).

Looks up member member of the member table at 0x00017398 (stride 0x24: 0x20-byte member name, then the archive index at +0x20; member 0 = mn_dj_title.ehf) with world_underground_find_member(name, archive index) and returns its pointer (the decompiler drops the return value). No side effects beyond those of world_underground_find_member. Callers: 20 (world_underground_draw_rungs, world_underground_player_draw, world_underground_draw_ladder_cells, world_underground_draw_end_row, ...).

Returns the texture for map member member in map tier tier: member 0x14 uses the name table at 0x000176cc, 0x13 the one at 0x000176ac, any other the one at 0x0001768c (mini_dj_map01_2/_1/_0.gim style names, 0x60 bytes per tier), copied into a 0x20-byte buffer and looked up with world_underground_find_member in the archive index of member member. Side effects as world_underground_find_member. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw_map_background).

Returns container_ehp_find_member(archive pointer, name) for the archive entry archive, or NULL when that archive is not loaded; when the last three characters of name equal the string at 0x00017a4c the member is also bound with container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, member). Side effects: member binding. Callers: 2 (world_underground_get_map_tier_gim, world_underground_get_member).

column2: int world_underground_load_sdchr(int slot, int character, int variant, void *callback, int arg)
column3: Starts loading the two sprite-character files of a character into sdchr slot slot (0x19ed4 + slot * 8 and +4): with world_character_has_field_model the names are the two words of world_get_character_model_entry_words, otherwise world_get_character_word_14 and world_get_character_word_10; each path is sprintf'd with underground/sdchr/%s and loaded with 0x000027c0(path, slot word, 0). Sets the load state 0x19ed0 = 2 and the completion callback/arg 0x19ec8/0x19ecc (fifth argument in t0). Returns slot. Side effects: loads, globals. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_load).
Returns sdchr pointer index (0 or 1) of slot slot (0x19ed4 + slot * 8 + index * 4). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_player_draw).

Frees the two sdchr pointers of slot slot (0x19ed4/0x19ed8 + slot * 8) with 0x00002774 and clears them. No return value. Side effects: heap, slot words. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_free_archives).

Runs container_ehp_run_extension_handlers on archive entry index, then frees its buffer with 0x00002774 and clears the pointer 0x00016ea0 + index * 0x24. No return value. Side effects: heap, archive table. Callers: 4 (world_underground_title_state_free, world_underground_game_state_free_archives, world_underground_result_state_free, world_underground_game_state_free_map).

Allocates size bytes from the module heap 0x19ec4 (system_heap_alloc, tail call) and returns the block. Installed as the field_3d allocator by world_underground_scene_start. Side effects: heap allocation. Callers: 2 (world_underground_load_file, world_underground_title_build_help). The pack's twin match with BOOT audio_heap_free is a false positive (jal targets masked).

Frees ptr from the module heap 0x19ec4 with system_heap_free (tail call) and returns its result. Installed as the field_3d free function by world_underground_scene_start. Side effects: heap release. Callers: 3 (world_underground_free_sdchr, world_underground_title_free_help, world_underground_free_archive). The pack's twin match with BOOT audio_heap_free is a false positive (the heap global differs; jal targets masked).

Returns the module heap handle 0x19ec4. No side effects. Callers: 7 (world_underground_title_open_info, world_underground_hud_build_floor_label, world_underground_result_state_open, world_underground_title_open_confirm, ...).

Returns the string-table path for the current language: the table at 0x00016f98 (first entry underground/strtbl_e.bin) + world_underground_get_language_index() * 0x80. No side effects. Callers: 6 (world_underground_title_draw_floor_picker, world_underground_title_build_help, world_underground_hud_build_floor_label, world_underground_title_state_build, ...).

Formats name with the format at 0x00017a68 into a 256-byte path, gets its size on root 8 (container_get_file_size), allocates that many bytes with world_underground_heap_alloc into *out_buffer and queues container_load_file(8, path, buffer, size, world_underground_on_file_loaded, arg) where arg is the buffer when bind is non-zero (the callback then binds it as an EHP) or 0. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, async file read. Callers: 2 (world_underground_load_archive, world_underground_load_sdchr).

Load-completion callback: returns 0 when size < 1; otherwise binds buffer with container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, buffer) when non-null, decrements the pending-load count 0x19ed0 and, when it reaches 0 and a completion callback 0x19ec8 is set, calls it with (buffer, 0x19ecc); returns 1. Side effects: EHP binding, 0x19ed0, the completion callback. No direct caller (passed to container_load_file by world_underground_load_file).

Returns the language-specific path (stride 0x80 per world_underground_get_language_index) of archive index 5 (table 0x00016fb8, result/mini_result_e.ehp), 3 (0x00016f78, underground/game_e.ehp) or 1 (0x00016f58, underground/titlemenu_e.ehp), copying 0x20 bytes to out when out is non-null; NULL for other indices. Side effects: out. Callers: 1 (world_underground_load_archive).

Initialises the game object (0x00019160): state +0x00 = 0, +0x04 = 1, +0x08..+0x20 = 0, eight slots +0x24 = 0, floor +0x44 = 1, +0x48/+0x4c = 0, the event words +0x11c..+0x16c (+0x124 = 1, +0x130/+0x134 = -1, +0x138 = 4, +0x140 = 1, +0x144 = 0x11, +0x148/+0x14c = 9, outcome +0x16c = 4), calls 0x0000830c, clears the scroll words +0x170..+0x17c, then initialises the floor view +0x180, the player +0x190 (0x00009294), 30 duelist records +0x1cc (0x24 bytes, 0x0000a8a0), 10 box records +0x604 (0x34 bytes, 0x000096bc), the cursor +0x80c (0x0000ac30), the HUD +0x830 (0x00009bf0) and +0xb2c (0x000116f4); message id +0xbb0 = 0x16 (none), +0xbb4 = 0, clears 0x60 bytes at +0xb50, music words +0xcb8/+0xcbc = 0xc, and records the game in 0x19ef4 with load step 0x19ef8 = 0. Returns 1. Side effects: the object and those globals. Callers: 1 (world_underground_load_progress).

Ends the game object's sub-objects: +0xb2c (0x0001171c), HUD +0x830 (0x00009c44), cursor +0x80c (0x0000ac68), player +0x190 (0x000092e4), the 30 duelist records (0x0000a8c4), the 10 box records (0x00009700) and the floor view (world_underground_floor_view_term_nop). Returns 1. Side effects: those of the callees. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).

Per-frame update of the game object: dispatches on the state +0x00 (0 init, 1 load, 2/5 wait for loads, 3 floor setup, 4 load map, 6 hide loading, 7 fade in, 8 wait fade, 9 choose column, 10 wait message, 0xb view map, 0xc start walk, 0xd play, 0xe event scroll, 0xf event begin, 0x10 event run, 0x11 event end, 0x12 fade out, 0x13 after fade, 0x14 free map, 0x15 free archives, 0x16 done). In states 7..0x13 (except during a duel) it picks the music track +0xcbc (0xe when the timer +0x20 is 0, else 0xc) and calls audio_play_track_with_fade on a change, and updates the floor view, the player (unless state 0x10 kind 0), the active duelist and box records, the cursor, the HUD, the +0xb2c object at the player position, the message (0x00007944) and the info panel (0x00007b68). Returns 1 in state 0x16, else 0. Side effects: game object, music. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns player + 0xc, the player's pixel y on the map. No side effects. Callers: 13 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, ...).
Returns player + 8, the player's pixel x on the map. No side effects. Callers: 13 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, ...).

Draws the game object on layer 1. During a duel (state 0x10, kind 2, substate 3) only the duel object +0xa60 (0x0000da4c); outside states 7..0x13 nothing. Otherwise world_underground_draw_map(floor view, list, scroll +0x170, +0x174), then on even floors the boxes (0x0000974c), duelists (0x0000a910) and player (0x00009330), on odd floors player, duelists, boxes (draw order by walking direction), then +0xb2c (0x000117a8), the cursor (0x0000acb4), the message (0x00007974), the info panel (0x00007bd0) and the HUD (0x00009ca8); 0x0000738c and 0x0000792c are drawn on top for particular states/substates (state 10, 9, 0xb and event substates). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw).

column2: void world_underground_game_start(void *game, int run_flag, int column, int floor, int lp, int lp_max, int *slots)
column3: Starts a run: player column and target column (+0x190 +0x10/+0x18) = column when run_flag is set, else 2 (middle); +0x10 = run_flag, floor +0x44, LP +0x14 = lp, max LP +0x18 = lp_max, tool uses +0x1c = 5, timer +0x20 = 1000, +0x48/+0x4c = 0, slots +0x24..+0x40 copied from slots, won-card count +0x50 = 0 and the 200-byte card list +0x54 cleared (arguments 5-7 in t0-t2). No return value. Side effects: the game object. Callers: 1 (world_underground_start_game).
Returns player + 0x18, the column the player is heading to. No side effects. Callers: 10 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_start, ...).
Returns player + 0x10, the player's current column 0..4. No side effects. Callers: 13 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_start, ...).
True when the game state is above 6 (map loaded and shown). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_draw).

True when the game is in state 0x10 with event kind +0x138 = 2 (duelist) and substate +0x13c = 3 (the duel itself runs). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_is_duel_lib_active, world_underground_draw).
True when world_underground_game_is_in_duel and world_underground_duel_is_running(duel object game +0xa60) are both true. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_should_run_duel_frame).

Adds one copy of each won card to the save: for i < +0x50 calls save_change_card_count(halfword at +0x54 + i * 4, 1). No return value. Side effects: save card counts. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
Returns the player's column (player +0x190, +0x10), saved as the resume column. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_update_game).
State 0: clears the exit count (world_underground_ladder_reset_exit_count) and sets the state to 1. No return value. Side effects: state, 0x1a41c. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 1: advances the load step 0x19ef8 (0 -> 1) and starts the matching load with completion callback 0x00008070 and argument 0x19ef4: step 1 loads the sprite characters of character 1 variant 0 into sdchr slot 0, step 2 archive 2, step 3 archive 3 (game_e); sets the state to 2. No return value. Side effects: loads, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 3: sets up the floor (0x00005fa4) and goes to state 4 (load the map archive) when the map-loaded flag +0x0c is 0, else to state 6. No return value. Side effects: game object. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 4: sets the load step 0x19ef8 = 4 and loads archive 4 with the map name of tier floor view +8 (world_underground_load_archive(4, 0x00008070, 0x19ef4, tier)); state 5. No return value. Side effects: load, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).
Returns view +8, the map tier (floor - 1) / 10. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_load_map).
State 6: sets state 7 and hides the loading overlay (system_set_loading_overlay(0)). No return value. Side effects: state, overlay. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 7: sets the map-loaded flag +0x0c = 1, when +0x04 is set starts the music track +0xcb8 with audio_play_track_with_fade, starts a fade-in (type 1, black, 16 frames) and sets state 8. No return value. Side effects: state, music, fade. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 8: once the fade is done shows message 8 and goes to state 0xb (view the map) or shows message 7 and goes to state 9 (choose the start column): message 7 / state 9 when +0x04 is set and the run flag +0x10 is 0, or when slot 6 (+0x3c) is at least 4; otherwise message 8 / state 0xb (0x000073fc). No return value. Side effects: state, message. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 9: while no slide runs, confirm (with follow mode +0x124) closes the message and either plays 0x7a05 and goes to state 0xc (+0x04 clear) or shows message 0xd and goes to state 10; cancel re-centres the view on the player; in follow mode left/right (repeat, mask 0x80/0x20) moves the target column 0..4 and starts a 5-frame slide (sound 0x7a04), the direction button opposite to the walking direction (0x10 or 0x40 by floor parity) leaves follow mode; outside follow mode the d-pad scrolls the view by 16 px (x 0..0x1e8, y 0..0x4f0). During a slide (+0x120) the player x is interpolated over 5 frames (0x00005f34) and the camera follows; at the end the column is set and 0x000044b0 is run. No return value. Side effects: game and player fields, sounds. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

Writes visible to player +0x30, the flag that world_underground_player_draw and world_underground_game_draw_column_arrows test (cleared during a column slide, set to 1 after it and at floor setup). No return value. Side effects: player +0x30. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_choose_column).
Returns player + 0x1c, the row the player is heading to. No side effects. Callers: 7 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, ...).
Returns player + 0x14, the player's current row 0..0x11. No side effects. Callers: 10 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, ...).

State 10, entered after effect 0xd is started by world_underground_game_state_choose_column or world_underground_game_state_view_map: when world_underground_game_is_effect_done reports done stops the effect (world_underground_game_stop_effect) and sets state 0xc. No return value. Side effects: state, +0xbb0, those of world_underground_game_is_effect_done. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 0xb: confirm (in follow mode) closes the message and plays 0x7a05 and sets state 0xc, or shows message 0xd and sets state 10 when +0x04 is set; cancel re-enters follow mode and centres the view on the player; the d-pad leaves follow mode and scrolls the view by 16 px (x 0..0x1e8, y 0..0x4f0). No return value. Side effects: game fields, sounds. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 0xc: starts the player walking (0x00009590(player, 1)), sets the moving flag +0x11c = 1, copies the player's target column/row into all four cursor words (+0x80c +0xc..+0x18), shows the cursor, sets the scroll targets +0x178/+0x17c to the player position, clears +0x04 and sets state 0xd. No return value. Side effects: game, player and cursor fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

Writes visible to cursor +0x20. No return value. Side effects: cursor +0x20. Callers: 4 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, world_underground_game_state_event_scroll, world_underground_game_handle_cursor).

Returns cursor + 0x18 (second row word, set together with +0x10). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, world_underground_game_state_play, world_underground_game_handle_cursor).

Returns cursor + 0x14 (second column word, set together with +0x0c). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, world_underground_game_state_play, world_underground_game_handle_cursor).

Returns cursor + 0x10, the cursor row. No side effects. Callers: 9 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_run_tool_event, world_underground_game_is_effect_done, world_underground_game_state_play, ...).
Returns cursor + 0x0c, the cursor column. No side effects. Callers: 9 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_run_tool_event, world_underground_game_is_effect_done, ...).

Returns player + 0x24, the facing direction (0, 2, 4, 6 written by the walk code). No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_state_start_walk, world_underground_game_walk_player).

State 0xd: regenerates LP (world_underground_game_regen_lp), ticks the timer (world_underground_game_tick_timer), tests the duelists (world_underground_game_check_duelist_hit) and boxes (world_underground_game_check_box_hit), runs the cursor input (enabled only when neither was hit) and, when nothing was hit, walks the player. On an end-row arrival sets the event kind +0x138 = 3, on a duelist hit 2, on a box hit 1; each stops the player (0x00009590(player, 0)), resets the slide counter when not following, and sets state 0xe. No return value. Side effects: game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

Moves the player one step along the ladder. Speed is 6 px per frame while the confirm button is held (player +0x34 = 1), otherwise 1 px every other frame (+0x160 toggles). While moving (+0x11c) steps the pixel position toward the target cell (column x 0x0000867c, row y 0x000086bc) and sets the direction (2 left, 6 right, 4 up, 0 down); on arrival it snaps, and at row 0 or 0x11 records the cell and returns 1; after a vertical step it checks the rung tests 0x00008598 (column - 1) and 0x00008600 (column + 1) and turns, otherwise continues one row in the floor's direction (up on even floors, down on odd ones); after a horizontal step it continues vertically. Keeps the camera on the player when following (+0x124). Returns 1 when the end row is reached, else 0. Side effects: player fields, scroll. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_play).
Writes running to player +0x34 (confirm held = fast walk). No return value. Side effects: player +0x34. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_walk_player).

For each of the +0x128 duelist records (0x24 bytes at +0x1cc) that is active updates it toward the player (0x0000ab70) and tests the collision (0x0000ab1c) with the player pixel position; on a hit stores the index in +0x134 and returns 1. Returns 0 when nothing is hit. Side effects: duelist records, +0x134. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_state_play, world_underground_game_state_choose_column).
Returns duelist +0x20 (active flag). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_check_duelist_hit).

For each of the +0x12c box records (0x34 bytes at +0x604) that is active tests the player pixel position with 0x00009ae8; on a hit stores the index in +0x130 and returns 1, else returns 0. Side effects: +0x130. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_play).
Returns box +0x24 (active flag). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_check_box_hit).

Map input while walking. When no re-centre animation runs and enabled is set: shows the cursor; pad button 0x8000 with tool uses +0x1c > 0 on a cell where 0x00008540 or 0x0000856c holds uses a tool (+0x1c decremented, HUD +0x14 cleared through 0x00004aa0, event kind 0, state 0xf); the cancel button outside follow mode starts the re-centre animation (sound 0x7a04); the d-pad leaves follow mode, scrolls the view by 16 px and moves the cursor to the cell under the screen centre (column (x + 0x3d) / 0x7a clamped 0..4, row (y + 0x25) / 0x4a clamped 1..16, sound 0x7a04 on a change); in follow mode the cursor tracks the player. The re-centre animation interpolates the scroll over 5 frames toward the player and then re-enters follow mode. Returns true when no animation is running. Side effects: game and cursor fields, sounds. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_state_event_scroll, world_underground_game_state_play).
Writes value to HUD +0x14 (the displayed tool-use count). No return value. Side effects: HUD. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_handle_cursor, world_underground_game_refresh_hud).

When slot 4 (+0x34) is at least 4, every 60 frames (counter +0x158) adds max LP / 100 to LP +0x14 (capped at +0x18) and updates the HUD LP; otherwise clears the counter. No return value. Side effects: LP, HUD, counter. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_play).
Writes lp to HUD +0x0c. No return value. Side effects: HUD. Callers: 3 (world_underground_game_regen_lp, world_underground_game_run_duel_event, world_underground_game_refresh_hud).

While the timer +0x20 is positive decrements it every 10 frames (every 30 frames when slot 1 (+0x28) is above 3; counter +0x15c), clamping at 0, and updates the HUD timer. No return value. Side effects: timer, HUD. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_play).
Writes value to HUD +0x18. No return value. Side effects: HUD. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_tick_timer, world_underground_game_refresh_hud).

State 0xe: for event kinds 1-3 hides the cursor and, when the view is not following, runs world_underground_game_handle_cursor(game, 0) and a 5-frame scroll back to the target (0x00005f08); then for kinds 1 and 2 moves the cursor to the player's target cell. Kind 0, or the end of the scroll, sets follow mode and state 0xf. No return value. Side effects: game and cursor fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 0xf: begins the event of kind +0x138: 3 world_underground_game_begin_goal_event, 2 world_underground_game_begin_duel_event, 1 world_underground_game_begin_box_event, 0 world_underground_game_begin_tool_event; state 0x10 when it returns non-zero. No return value. Side effects: state, those of the callees. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

Plays effect 6 (world_underground_game_play_effect) and sets the event substate +0x13c = 0 and limit +0x140 = 1. Returns 1: the constant loaded in v0 for the limit stays there up to the return, and world_underground_game_state_event_begin tests it, although Ghidra shows no return value. Side effects: effect fields and sound of world_underground_game_play_effect, game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_begin).

Marks the touched box (+0x130) opened, gets its type (0x000087cc), rolls the box result with 0x00006388 into +0x144, picks the slot for result 8 (0x00006578), shows message 0xb for results 0..3, 10 for 4..8 and 0xe, 7 for 9..0xd (else none), sets the box display (0x00009b3c) and plays 0x7ab2 for message 7, else 0x7ab3 for box type 2 or 0x7ab1; substate 0, limit 6. Returns 1. Side effects: box record, game fields, message, sounds, RNG. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_begin).
Writes value to box +0x28. No return value. Side effects: box record. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_begin_box_event).
Sets the event substate +0x13c = 0 and limit +0x140 = 9. Returns 1. Side effects: game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_begin).
Sets the event substate +0x13c = 0 and limit +0x140 = 2. Returns 1. Side effects: game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_begin).

State 0x10: runs the event of kind +0x138 (3 0x000057f0, 2 0x00005448, 1 world_underground_game_run_box_event, else world_underground_game_run_tool_event) and sets state 0x11 when it returns non-zero. No return value. Side effects: state, those of the callees. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

Tool event: in substate 0, once the message is done (0x00007134) closes it and toggles the rung at the cursor cell: 0x00008668 when 0x00008540 holds there, else 0x00008674; increments the substate. Returns 1 when done (substate reached the limit +0x140). Side effects: ladder data, message, game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_run).

Box event substates +0x13c: 0 waits for the message, applies the result +0x144 (0x00006610, except result 0xd) and goes to 1 for results 0xe, 7 and 3 (cards awarded) or 2; 1 -> 2; 2 waits for the box animation (0x00009b8c) and shows message 1; 3 waits for confirm (and for sound 0x7ab3 to end on result 0xe), closes the box (0x00009b80) and message, refreshes the HUD (0x000068a4) and then shows message 0xf (result 0xe), the slot message (result 8 unless +0x14c is 9), message 8 (results 5 and 1) or, for result 9 with LP below 1, sets player +0x38 and shows message 0xe (substate 5); 4 and 5 wait for the message. Returns 1 when done or substate >= limit. Side effects: game fields, messages, HUD. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_run).

Writes spinning to player +0x38 (set to 1 when a box result 9 leaves the LP at 0 or below and when a duel is lost): while it is set world_underground_player_animate advances +0x2c and world_underground_player_draw cycles the direction from it and clears walking. No return value. Side effects: player +0x38. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_run_box_event, world_underground_game_run_duel_event).

Duelist event, substates +0x13c: 0 stops the BGM (fade 10) and shows text 0; 1 after 30 frames or confirm closes the text and starts a white fade-out; 2 when faded initialises (0x0000d99c) and starts (0x0000dadc(floor, LP, slot 0 > 3)) the duel object +0xa60; 3 when the duel ends (0x0000d9b0) reads deck_get_duel_setup_tail_block() +0x20 (result, 1 = won) into +0x150 and +0x28 (remaining LP) into LP +0x14 (capped at max) and the HUD; on a win increments the duels-won count +0x4c, deactivates the duelist (+0x134), recentres the view, restarts the floor music and resets the cursor (0x0000af34), on a loss sets player +0x38; ends the duel object (0x0000d9a8) and fades in; 4 on a win rolls a reward (world_underground_game_roll_duel_reward) into +0x144, picks a slot and applies it, then shows text 1 (results 2 and 8, substate 7), goes to 5 (result 0x10) or finishes; on a loss plays effect 0xe (substate 6); 5 shows text 1; 6 and 8 wait for the effect; 7 on confirm closes the text and refreshes the HUD, then plays the slot effect when result 8 raised a slot to its maximum. Returns 1 when finished or at the substate limit +0x140. Side effects: game fields, duel object, music, fades, text, effects. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_run).
Writes active to duelist +0x20. No return value. Side effects: duelist record. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_run_duel_event).

End-row event: in substate 0 shows text 3, 4 or 5 according to which end-row test holds at the player's cell (0x000084f0, 0x000084f8, 0x00008500) and advances; in substate 1 confirm closes the text and finishes. Returns 1 when done or at the substate limit. Side effects: text window, substate. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_run).

State 0x11: calls the end handler of event kind +0x138 (3 world_underground_game_end_goal_event, 2 world_underground_game_end_duel_event, 1 world_underground_game_end_box_event, else world_underground_game_resume_play) and resets the kind to 4. No return value. Side effects: state, those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).
Sets the game state to 0xd (play). No return value. Side effects: state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_end).

After a box: LP below 1 -> outcome +0x16c = 1 and state 0x12; result 0xe -> outcome 0 and state 0x12; result 0xd -> snaps the column to the target column and goes to state 0x12 (the floor is rebuilt); otherwise deactivates the box (+0x130), restarts walking (0x00009590(player, 1)) and returns to state 0xd. No return value. Side effects: game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_end).
Writes active to box +0x24. No return value. Side effects: box record. Callers: 2 (world_underground_game_setup_floor, world_underground_game_end_box_event).

After a duel: when +0x150 is 1 (won) restarts walking and returns to state 0xd, otherwise sets outcome 1 and state 0x12. No return value. Side effects: game fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_end).

After reaching the end row (column snapped to the target): cell type 0x000084f0 lowers the floor +0x44 and the floor gain +0x48 by one (only when the floor is above 1), 0x000084f8 raises both by one, 0x00008500 plays 0x7ab8, stops the BGM (fade 0x5dc) and sets outcome 2 (left the underground); each goes to state 0x12. No return value. Side effects: game fields, sound. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_state_event_end).

State 0x12: starts a black fade-out (16 frames), stops all sounds (fade 0x5dc) unless the outcome +0x16c is 4 (next floor), and sets state 0x13. No return value. Side effects: fade, audio, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 0x13, once the fade is done: outcomes 0, 1 and 2 go to state 0x14 (leave). Otherwise re-applies result 0xd when it was the last result (0x00006610), regenerates the floor data (0x000084bc), shows the floor on the HUD (0x00009e60) and goes to state 0x14 (reload the map archive) when the floor crossed into another tier of 10 (going down: floor % 10 == 0; going up: floor > 1 and floor % 10 == 1), else to state 3. No return value. Side effects: state, floor data, HUD. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 0x14: frees archive 4 (the map), clears the map-loaded flag +0x0c and goes to state 0x15 for outcomes 0, 1, 2, else back to state 3. No return value. Side effects: heap, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_game_update).

State 1: advances the load step 0x1a424 (0 -> 1) and loads archive 0 (step 1) or archive 1 (step 2, language menu archive) with callback world_underground_title_on_load_done and context 0x1a420; state 2. No return value. Side effects: loads, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

State 4: starts music track 0xb, finds the language string table in archive 1 and formats dictionary words into the menu strings: title 0x25 -> 0x1a430, five item descriptions (word numbers from 0x00017fe4) -> 0x1a470 + i * 0x40, prompts 4, 2, 1, 3 -> 0x1a5b0/0x1a5f0/0x1a630/0x1a670, and word 0x15 with floor and best -> 0x1a6b0; starts the menu ehf member 1 (all frames) in +0x28 with a cleared parameter block +0x30, fades in (white when the intro flag is set, else black, 16 frames), sets +0x08 = 1 and state 5. No return value. Side effects: string buffers, music, fade, the object. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

State 5: once the fade is done sets state 6 and opens the header (title text), the menu list and the info window. No return value. Side effects: windows, state. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

State 6: reads the menu (world_underground_title_step_menu); cancel or item 4 opens the quit prompt (state 0xc), item 3 builds the help pages (state 0xb), item 2 opens the deck prompt (state 10), item 1 sets the start floor to 1 with its fee and opens the floor picker (state 8), item 0 opens the enter prompt (state 7); the chosen item is kept in +0x04 and the header and menu windows are rebuilt as needed. No return value. Side effects: the object, windows. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

No return value. Side effects: module load, the object, windows. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

State 10: on yes sets choice 2 and state 0xd; on no returns to the menu with cursor 2. No return value. Side effects: the object, windows. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

State 0xc: on yes sets choice 3 and state 0xd; on no returns to the menu with cursor 4. No return value. Side effects: the object, windows. Callers: 1 (world_underground_title_update).

Then total DP +0x38 = base + bonus, EXP +0x3c = total / 25, save_add_dp(total), and save_add_duelist_exp(EXP); a level-up adds 400 DP more. No return value. Side effects: save DP/EXP/records/record flags, story score, screen fields. Callers: 1 (world_underground_result_screen_create).

Side effects: those of the state handlers. Callers: 1 (world_underground_result_screen_update).

Screen state 3: when a face button is pressed sets the result +0x24 = 3 and either (flag +0x1c == 1) plays the outro (ehf 0 frames 0x61..0x65), stops the BGM (fade 600), fades out and sets state 5, or opens a message window with text 0xd of the result string table (world_underground_result_open_window, one button) and sets state 4. No return value. Side effects: the screen, audio, fade, UI. Callers: 1 (world_underground_result_screen_step).

No return value. Side effects: the screen, UI, audio, fade. Callers: 1 (world_underground_result_screen_step).
